models.name: o4-mini
models.desc: Compact fast reasoning model released alongside o3 (Apr 16, 2025). 200K context; docs cutoff Jun 1, 2024.

models.name: GPT-4.1
models.desc: API-first flagship non-reasoning model; 1,047,576-token context. OpenAI docs describe it as the 'smartest non-reasoning model' (knowledge cutoff Jun 1, 2024).

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
models.desc: Snapshot ID claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. Extended thinking toggleable, off by default -> hybrid. Context conflict: OpenRouter endpoint serves 1M context while Anthropic docs list 200k standard (1M available as beta via context-1m header); per instructions we trust the OpenRouter endpoint (1M). Training data cutoff Jul 2025 (reliable Jan 2025). $3/$15 per MTok. Thinking output summarized, never raw CoT.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.desc: Auto fuzzy 'Qwen-1_8B' rejected: that is the original Qwen (v1) 1.8B, unrelated. Native context 32,768; 131,072 via YaRN.

models.name: Qwen3 VL 30B A3B Instruct
models.desc: Small VL MoE (30.5B total / ~3.3B active, same MoE base as Qwen3-30B-A3B); official announcement tweet 2025-10-04, QwenLM GitHub timeline lists October 4, 2025. Official model supports video input; OR endpoint lists text+image only.

models.name: GLM-4.6
models.desc: Same 355B-A32B structure as GLM-4.5 with context expanded 128K -> 200K; thinking enable/disable toggle in the Z.ai API. HF param counter shows 357B (incl. MTP heads). One secondary source (IntuitionLabs) says Apache-2.0, but the HF repo license is MIT - HF taken as authoritative.

models.name: Ling-2.6-flash
models.desc: Small non-thinking instruct MoE (104B total / 7.4B active, 1:7 MLA + Lightning linear-attention hybrid). OpenRouter listed 2026-04-21, i.e. API availability preceded the 2026-04-28 open-weights release on HF - hence release_date flag. int4 and base variants also published by inclusionAI.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
models.desc: April 2026 V4 launch build (referred to as V4-Flash Preview after the 0731 official release superseded it). Hybrid modes: Non-think / Think High / Think Max. 1M context via Compressed Sparse Attention + Heavily Compressed Attention; FP4+FP8 mixed-precision weights. Fuzzy ECI suggestion 'DeepSeek-V4-Pro' rejected - different tier (Pro is 1.6T-A49B). Some third-party pages describe V4 as multimodal, but the OR endpoint and HF card are text-only.

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
models.desc: GA release (2026-05-07) of the first Flash-Lite model in the Gemini 3 series (preview 2026-03-03). OpenRouter accepts a reasoning parameter and all Gemini 3-series Flash models expose thinking_level incl. minimal, but this exact model was not in the thinking-docs matrix I retrieved, so hybrid is inferred from series behavior - flagged. ECI entry is dated 2026-03-03 (the preview release); GA is presumed the same model, hence 'likely' rather than 'exact'.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.7
models.desc: Released 2026-04-16 (also Axios/CNBC 2026-04-16). Introduced a new tokenizer (same text produces roughly 30% more tokens than pre-4.7 models) and the xhigh effort level. Adaptive thinking off by default; rejects legacy extended thinking (400) -> hybrid. Training data cutoff Jan 2026. $5/$25 per MTok, 1M context, 128k max output.
